replication.target_description: Experiment 1b replication: speedboat moral acceptability, Speedboat Oar (personal force only) versus Speedboat Accelerate (no personal force), Welch independent t-test.

n.sample_role: Participants in two mutually exclusive final between-subjects groups in the target Welch independent t-test.
n.exclusions: Analysis Plan excludes those confused (N = 7) or lacking realism (N = 11); these study-wide counts are not allocated to target groups. Final target group counts are given directly in Table 2.
n.location: Table 2, canonical page 15, Speedboat Oar versus Speedboat Accelerate; Table 1 study design; Analysis Plan, canonical page 7.

notes: Identity assessment: canonical text has the exact referenced title and authors Trent Lynds & Sean P. Mackinnon. This is a primary empirical replication report with Methods, Results and final test Table 2. The author note describes an archived, non-peer-reviewed shortened 2020 honours thesis; a footnote was added in 2024. Its own DOI is not printed, so DOI identity cannot be independently confirmed from this cache alone. Source URL is https://osf.io/download/wfmau/. No PDF path supplied. Target assignment uses the explicit statement Experiment 1a (footbridge) and Experiment 1b (speedboat) on canonical page 8, plus the named personal-force tests in Analysis Plan, hypotheses and Table 2, rather than row order or numeric agreement. Supplied replication page locators do not coincide with final Table 2; target matching follows study/outcome/test descriptions. Speedboat Oar n = 74 + Speedboat Accelerate n = 86 = 160 participants. Table 1 identifies conditions 2 and 3 as mutually exclusive between-subjects groups. Each participant supplies both dilemma families, so no summation across footbridge and speedboat. Standard-condition n = 90 is excluded from this contrast; recruitment N = 268 is not used. Only n_r was assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders.
